announcements.title: You're invited to Delta on Google Play
announcements.body: We're pleased to inform you that Delta is now a closed test on Google Play. As an early user, you are being offered a place before it goes public. Join the group with your phone's Google account, then tap Not now here for step 2.

announcements.title: Become a tester and install
announcements.body: Open the Play page, tap "Become a tester", then install Delta. It can take a little while to appear after you join the group. Thank you for being an early user.
